# Module `rand`

rand - pseudo-random integers.

Thin wrappers over the runtime's `__vyb_rand_*` functions in
`runtime/vyb_runtime.c`. `rand` yields an Int in [0, 2^63-1]; `rand_range`
yields one in [lo, hi). `rand_seed` makes a sequence reproducible (seeded
identically in the same process), which deterministic tests rely on.
